title: Human tasks checklist
summary: Manual gates for the learning loop, knob calibration, and promotion decisions. Automated weekday runs are listed for context — verify, do not duplicate. Cadence map: docs/ops/ops-review-cadence.md.

tasks.title: Spot-check learning tracks after paper-auto
tasks.summary: ops-monitor (13:15 catch-up) checks post-settle last_run, decision-review coverage of the assessment-model primary (ai_judgment_fair) and control (buy_tier_level), active calibrated shadows, and buy_tier_level fill. Frozen tracks are skipped. Workflow freshness covers CI acted. Excess vs ^FTSE comparison stays Sunday — do not promote on weekday marks.

tasks.title: Paper-auto + decision-review apply
tasks.summary: Runs all active learning tracks (frozen tracks in paper_automation/assessment_model.json are skipped), refreshes overlay, appends rebalance_log, applies clamped knobs only when history is thick and the significance gate passes (significance_gate_v1: track_statistics verdict positive/negative; --force does not bypass). Shadows and the cohort lab are observe-only (no --apply); endurance ledger refreshes after review.

tasks.title: GHA secret hygiene scan
tasks.summary: Daily Actions scan for public-repo workflow_run secret-exposure patterns. Skips when no main merges / workflow touches in the last 36h; always runs on PRs that change workflows. Failures open a supervised engineering task.

tasks.title: Admitted epoch-0 local-open marks
tasks.summary: library-epoch0-weekday.yml marks admitted buy_tier_level books after ASX / EU / US open+settle. Session gate skips pre-settle and already-marked local days. No AI track, no knob apply, not FTSE paper-auto at 08:25 UTC. Census refresh writes equal_support_status.json.

tasks.title: Epoch-0 weekday local-open crons (admit + sync)
tasks.summary: On learning admit and on euro-ingest-dispatch --sync-cron, upsert timezone-bucket cron-job.org jobs (asx/euro/us-edt/us-est) for admitted markets. Ingest/sprint/maintenance workflows pass CRONJOB_API_KEY + WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT. Soft-skips when secrets are missing. Do not attach these to FTSE weekday_paper at 08:25 UTC.

tasks.title: Admitted-market weekday rememo
tasks.summary: After library ingest maintenance, rememo up to 3 body-lag buy-tier names per admitted/epoch-0 market (same cap as FTSE). Catch-up to 5 when that market's backlog exceeds 15. Once per weekday. No AI / no Sunday dump / no 21-market spray.

tasks.title: Glance Daily hub before acting on chat todos
tasks.summary: Before acting on chat or Project notes todos, open Automation → Daily (#automation/daily). Prefer a grounded status skim (ops warns/fails, scoreboard headline, eng queue head, defer triggers, post-run clearance) plus two labeled lanes: (1) Push — at most 1–3 execution suggestions that cite those facts and respect P1/P2 for what to do today (fail-closed empty over padding); (2) Explore — may sit outside North Star / AGENTS spend priorities (new levers, process/AI ideas, post-sell cues) but must be labeled not-today, meet a quality bar (concrete claim + why it might matter + what would falsify or promote), and route durable items to ftse-defer add/fragment — never displace Push or become unbounded brainstorm. Focus P1/P2 lines are north-star chips (relevance-gated); do not ritual-Accept them. Act on market warning triage only when deepen/dismiss/park is decision-relevant (zero_body/unmeasured not dismissable; spare stall → park; bare health=warn stays email/monitor — do not divert offline ingest / maintenance capacity). Prefer new_info / triggered human gates (saturated knobs, volume-ready, parked backlog when pause still fires) over quiet ack theater. Check History for yesterday’s Accept followed vs Discuss resolved. Hub fresh before 04:00 Europe/London (early ops-monitor ~02:30 UTC). Suite A stress green / graduated badges ≠ adoption. Accept = observe-ack only; Discuss → Project pickup for deepen / capacity. Accept-streak hints observe-only — never auto-flip automated:true. Redesign forks D1–D7: Project store docs/daily-hub-attention-redesign.md.

tasks.title: Clear engineering parked backlog when dispatch pauses
tasks.summary: Hourly recover-queue self-heals first (cancel resolved/superseded gap-closure parks; unpark healed preflight_clash) before the cap-8 pause/email. When attention_parked_count=0 and queue_clearing.pause_active=false, board rebuild auto-acks observe-only (quiet fingerprint) — no list-parked work. When the warning still fires after recover-queue, triage remaining oldest parks via `ftse-engineering list-parked` (merge, cancel, or unpark). Queue auto-resumes when count drops below 7 and 30 minutes have elapsed since the last clearing action. Separate from project-traffic pause (stuck CI/conflict PRs).

tasks.title: Project traffic pause / unstick / EOD digest
tasks.summary: Weekday project-traffic (and ops-monitor) classifies stuck cursor/* PRs, pauses new engineering-agent dispatch, comments for CI/conflict fixes (appending pr_fix_occasions.json with failure reasons), may dispatch conflict-resolve for eng branches, stops Composer reburn / Cursor fail-loop automation waste (park burning tasks + pause), and writes a grounded EOD digest that lists today's eng merges (including independently verified ingest_narrow / scoring_narrow / compile_cap_drain auto-merges) plus common PR-fix failure reasons. Automation → Queue & hunter monitor shows today/yesterday merge counts, a 14-day auto vs manual merge bar chart, and PR-fix intervention tallies. Spot-check digest trajectory and the merges-today list when pause is active, auto-merges land, or a cohesion_bypass task still needed human merge because the actual diff stayed over the path cap.

tasks.title: Confirm buy-tier level cohort first fill
tasks.summary: ops-monitor fails when buy_tier_level acted with an empty book. Knobs stay frozen. Do not treat first-fill NAV as promotion truth (Sunday gates).

tasks.title: FTSE buy-tier level DCA realism (£500/mo)
tasks.summary: Paper-auto runs buy_tier_level_dca (same level-book policy, monthly_deposit=500, cold-start capital epoch). Overlays FTSE Overview held-vs-market as branch series with deposit-matched ^FTSE. Not a promotion gate; recycling buy_tier_level stays the primary held line.

tasks.title: Dual-path sleeve episodes (observe-only)
tasks.summary: Paper-auto opens/updates widest sleeve episodes (near-buy hold@≥0.28 or buy-tier → grace-end+~1m / fallback leave-wide×confirms+~1m) with capital_status tags (on_book / off_book / never_funded). Does not change allocation or NAV scoreboard. Manual: ftse-sleeve-episodes.

tasks.title: Read analysis review synthesis
tasks.summary: After analysis-review (~10:35 UTC), read analysis_review.md for backward metrics, proposed experiments, ingest trials, and the observe-only buy-tier chart-outcome mix (well timed / giveback / no terrible).

tasks.title: Phase C readiness assessment (observe-only)
tasks.summary: Sunday analysis-review runs ftse-phase-c-readiness and writes docs/data/phase_c_readiness.json. Checks Phase B slim evidence, ≥8 weeks AI-judgment rebalance_log with buy-tier/candidates, and non-trivial feature coverage. Does not fail the Sunday job on NOT READY.

tasks.title: Start Phase C freeze writer only when readiness is READY
tasks.summary: Before building or enabling the PIT autopsy freeze writer, confirm phase_c_readiness.json (or ftse-phase-c-readiness exit 0) is READY. Do not start Phase C on vibes or with --force-phase-b-done alone — that override does not invent rebalance history or feature coverage.

tasks.title: Watch shard epoch-0 and near-miss before forking AI
tasks.summary: Admitted markets (sp500, asx200) run a frozen buy-tier-level book plus equal-support. The AI-fork watch cut is buy-not-now (timing wait on buy-tier) and hold-near-buy (hold at or above 0.28). not-buy-tier and never-buy-tier are census/persistence inventories, not the sample. Do not spawn shard AI-judgment or decision-review --apply until epoch-0 and the tight groups have marks. Knob apply is the same gate as forking the AI track. FTSE remains the data lead.

tasks.title: Watch ingest capacity as more markets come on stream
tasks.summary: Spare sprint auto-advance down the queue is correct. Crowded maintenance defaults to 2 markets/slot (L454); ftse-library maintenance-capacity-review steps width or proposes matrix from samples. Confirm library-ingest-maintenance still finishes inside 120 minutes; the 62-name deepen cap is usually not binding.

tasks.title: Admitted-market epoch-0 shard (buy-tier-level + near-miss)
tasks.summary: Ladder stamps equal-support timing (and near-miss / exclusion archives) before ftse-library shard-epoch0 so skip_timing_wait can drop timing_signal=wait from new buys. Wait names stay on the observe-only near_miss_watch.json sample. Sunday prefers first-time memos and rememos the focus book only; admitted body-lag rememo and local-open marks are weekday jobs. No AI-judgment track and no knob apply.

tasks.title: Review unified experiment assessment
tasks.summary: Read fail/continue/recommend only — recommend ≠ do-now. Failed calibration/exclusion shadows close the promote path. Already-acked recommends (e.g. entry_dca_overlay) do not inflate urgency. Remaining ana-* recommends are eng/manual capacity, not this Sunday gate. Acknowledge when blocking unacked promote/overlay recommends are empty; never auto-promote. Do not reopen N58/N59. Verify live board; 2026-09-03 emptied then-open task recommends.

tasks.title: Read the assessment scoreboard (primary vs control; promotion gate)
tasks.summary: Read docs/data/assessment_scoreboard.json (Analysis → Observe model switcher defaults to Strand A · live): continuity primary ai_judgment_fair (B3 evidentiary-demoted — not adoption/filter-skill truth; see policy_changes.evidentiary_demotion_ai_judgment_fair_v1) vs control buy_tier_level and FTAL.L on total return, the 90% interval, the 3% stress-cost column and whether the AI gate binds; also matched-30 shadow twins (NAV only vs each other), frozen hold5/graduated final records, knob_calibration_priors readiness (Acknowledge-and-stop when confidence low and score_gap <0.005), buy_cross_archive_review (observe-only), policy_changes, and nest sunday-ai-path-scoreboard as a subsection. Judgment evidence primary is N210 fair-cost episode % (shadow until volume gates). While that demotion stamp is present and primary_track is still ai_judgment_fair, the ops warn Primary book trails its control is not a Push card; the outstanding gap is Later (crown only after shadow volume gates). Approve a promotion only when fair-cost evidence clears gates; do not enlarge the live 3-name book mid-flight; do not back-label its NAV. Calibrated/exclusion/Suite A frozen. N200/N201/N210 are sealed observe-only alone scoreboards — never a second live capital path and never a promote gate from trailing alone (F8).

tasks.title: Matched-30 fund twin vs matched buy-tier control (B3 shadow)
tasks.summary: Triggered / nested under sunday-assessment-scoreboard (D4): Read ai_judgment_matched30_fair vs buy_tier_matched30_fair on common marked days (fair-cost fund NAV). Construction-matched filter LQ only — do not treat unmatched gaps vs full buy_tier_level as skill. Shadow until volume/mark gates; do not crown assessment primary; do not decision-review --apply (churn-policy twins). Judgment evidence primary remains N210 episode %.

tasks.title: Judge saturated decision-review knobs (no silent clamp step)
tasks.summary: When ops-monitor warns Decision-review knobs saturated at bounds, read saturated_knobs on that book's decision_review.json. The loop can no longer move that axis — decide whether the driver (concentration, cost model, churn) needs a policy change, a new cold-start epoch, or no action. If the only saturated book is evidentiary-demoted ai_judgment_fair under anti-C, that decision is already no action and the warn is not a Push card. If another book is saturated in the same finding, judge only that outstanding book. Do not invent another knob step or decision-review --apply from the finding alone.

tasks.title: Act on met deferred triggers
tasks.summary: When ops-monitor reports Deferred idea triggers met / unreadable / name frozen books (docs/data/deferred_trigger_check.json), pick up (ftse-defer status <ID> now), retarget (ftse-defer set-trigger), or close (ftse-defer status done|drop --note) each named idea. ftse-defer triggers shows the current list.

tasks.title: Review AI path scoreboard (agree/veto shadow; no per-name chat)
tasks.summary: With the Sunday analysis bundle, read the observe-only llm_agree_veto_shadow rollup (learning_tracks_llm_agree_veto.json + per-track llm_agree_veto_shadow_review.json): disagreement / abstain rates vs heuristic and vs still_in_buy_set marks; Phase status per Project store docs/ai-path-roadmap.md (shadow judge → filing evidence cards → later L605/N209/L606 beachhead). Meta-first checklist/scoreboard only — not per-ticker AI chat. Do not flip influences_live or promote hard veto (N173 parked). Weekday surface stays the ops-monitor warn LLM agree/veto shadow rollup missing; intended later finding title AI path scoreboard — Sunday review (auto_fixable=False) once a committed freshness flag exists. Nest neighbor: sunday-post-sell-cues (package M digest).

tasks.title: Scan post-sell cue digest (timing + selection; nest under AI-path / scoreboard)
tasks.summary: Thin Sunday nest (package M): with the analysis bundle / AI-path scoreboard neighborhood, skim docs/data/post_sell_cue_digest.json (ops finding Post-sell cue digest (observe)). Prefer current-epoch selection cues only; note epoch_unknown / older_epoch counts (fail-closed join from rebalance_log). Timing cues: N200 levers (label population ≠ FTSE control + registration_id), exit-timing/shadow readiness, archive near-miss with L121 caveat. Selection skeleton: in_buy_set_at_exit vs in_buy_set_now (do not treat still_in_buy_set as exit-time). Widen beyond FTSE control buy_tier_level is gated until every cue/row carries epoch keys (fork F) — do not widen from this nest. Park via ftse-defer; no --apply / no N205 seal / no new track. Hub Explore consumes hub_feed when sibling Status/Push/Explore lands.

tasks.title: Review entry DCA cadence when overlay readiness fires
tasks.summary: Ack via CLI or Lifecycle Acknowledge (observe-only — Do not execute DCA from ack). Review docs/data/entry_dca_adoption_plan.json. Lifecycle Start enables 4× weekly entry DCA on graduated_allocation only; that book is frozen (2026-10-07), so paper_execute_graduated stays blocked until execute is repointed to ai_judgment_graduated_fair (N135). Do not change starter fraction or apply to primary/live while beat_market is false.

tasks.title: Review dual-path sleeve episodes when tag cohorts mature
tasks.summary: When learning_tracks_sleeve_episodes readiness.ready_for_sleeve_timing_analysis is true (≥15 closed per on_book/off_book/never_funded), review stratified sleeve timing. Do not mix never_funded marks into NAV vs ^FTSE. Do not back-label historical NAV as sleeve evidence.

tasks.title: Review in-portfolio hypothesis integrity when losers breach tolerance
tasks.summary: If learning_tracks_hypothesis_integrity shows within_tolerance=false, broken_loser_count>0, or selection_feedback_flags, read track hypothesis_integrity.md. Prefer thesis-broken rotation over crude stops; do not auto-apply exit knobs.

tasks.title: Triage analysis_tasks experiments
tasks.summary: Persist/publish/apply high system_gaps flags auto-queue as eng-sgap-* (no agent dispatch). Triage remaining proposed produce/learning-clock flags with ftse-analysis-review promote. Phase B rememo is body-lag slim — do not promote thin_memo_counted_as_coverage as rememo-eligibility widening; thicken filings then existing rememo_reason. Scoring candidates remain eng-20260903-02 / eng-20260903-03 (observe-only; no assign_signal() edits). Keep paper_knobs and offline_sim manual; do not revive cancelled N58/N59 knob counterfactuals.

tasks.title: Triage paper-learning and learning-director tasks
tasks.summary: These queues have no promote CLI. Remaining: watch u4 (ldr-20260823-02) and exit-shadow (ana-20260728-04); leave L111 replay as continue. Buffered-hold and IMB.L audits are done. Do not reopen duplicate human-ack wrappers. Prefer the engineering queue for the two scoring tasks.

tasks.title: Full-period knob calibrate on the primary
tasks.summary: analysis-review.yml runs ftse-knob-calibrate with full_period_retrospective on the assessment-model primary (ai_judgment_fair; frozen books excluded), writes priors and refreshes endurance. Shadow spawn / warm-start are not scheduled while the phase-1 parent ai_judgment is frozen; frozen shadows show status frozen.

tasks.title: Follow unified ops review cadence
tasks.summary: Use the weekly → monthly → quarterly sequence in ops-review-cadence.md (analysis review, horizon scan, deferred ideas) rather than ad-hoc review order.

tasks.title: Horizon scan + deferred fragments
tasks.summary: First Sunday 11:00 UTC: weeder applies deterministic near-dup / already-an-idea DROPs; read horizon scan; triage remaining open fragments and deferred ideas. apply_fragments stays off unless you reviewed the markdown.

tasks.title: Review euro_depth filing/memo parity vs FTSE
tasks.summary: Check whether euro_depth buy-tier has usable euro_filings bodies and memo quality approaching FTSE; only then flip phase1_require_ai_beat_rules back on or promote to weekday Phase 3.

tasks.title: Review cycle-end Cursor surplus and provisional weekly-ops bump
tasks.summary: Near plan refresh day: ftse-library cycle-surplus assess with declared unused Ultra fraction, apply a 25% transfer into weekly_ops_cap only, then next cycle run review and --keep or --revert. 15% of listed plan credit / week is a warning on estimated weekly_ops USD, not a hard cap. Do not raise rememo daily caps, research_all_graduated, or offline memo density from leftover credit.

tasks.title: Review common PR check / merge fix-request reasons
tasks.summary: Run `ftse-project-traffic common-issues` (or read docs/data/pr_fix_occasions.json). Identify recurring CI or merge-conflict failure reasons from human and traffic-controller fix requests, then fix root causes (flakes, path guards, sync races) rather than one-off PR patches.

tasks.title: Deferred ideas review pass
tasks.summary: Review deferred-review.md; move items via ftse-defer status (done / drop / promote).

tasks.title: Read buy-cross archive review
tasks.summary: Triggered / nested under sunday-assessment-scoreboard (D4 collapse): After analysis-review, read buy_cross_archive_review.json: cross-book vs level comparison, week-0 cash, names that never entered because they stayed buy-tier. Observe-only — do not spawn a live cross book from sparse historic crossings.

tasks.title: Review knob calibration priors
tasks.summary: Triggered / nested under sunday-assessment-scoreboard (D4 collapse): Confirm readiness signals in knob_calibration_priors.json for the primary book (ai_judgment_fair; frozen books are listed under excluded_frozen_tracks) — confidence, score_gap_vs_runner_up, ready_for_*. If confidence is low/insufficient and score gap shows no discrimination (<0.005), Acknowledge (observe-only) and stop — do not promote. Promotion is a separate gate (sunday-assessment-scoreboard).

tasks.title: Hold-buffer twin vs primary (L541)
tasks.summary: B3 frozen (2026-10-15): ai_judgment_hold5_fair is frozen with underpowered 3-name parent — final record only; do not promote or unfreeze. Re-spawn from matched-30 epoch later if the exit-buffer LQ reopens. Nested under sunday-assessment-scoreboard for archival read only.

tasks.title: Graduated-allocation twin vs primary
tasks.summary: B3 frozen (2026-10-15): ai_judgment_graduated_fair is frozen with underpowered 3-name parent — final record only; do not promote or unfreeze. Do not read the 3% stress graduated_allocation book as evidence. Re-spawn from matched-30 epoch later if graduated sizing LQ reopens.

tasks.title: Lock recording plan before new learning strands
tasks.summary: Before opening a new analysis, counterfactual, or model-dev strand, answer the four freeze questions (unit, freeze-at-t, join-later, never-backfill) and validate with ftse-decision-recording. Use preview-freeze for coverage gaps. Do not enable the Phase C freeze writer until readiness is READY.

tasks.title: Pin learning question before registering a post-hsr alternate strand
tasks.summary: After freeze-extras is in force (docs/ops/post-hsr-freeze-extras.md), keep strand A as the sole live/capital path. N200 and N201 are sealed observe-only independently (dual observe OK). Before opening any further observe/capital alternate, pin one learning question and registration_id, answer the four freeze questions, and respect the sealed-strategy launch queue (do not steal P1 from holdings/running units). Prefer P1/P2 spend until that pin is deliberate. At most one live promotion path.

tasks.title: Review N200/N201 volume gates when ops-monitor marks ready (no auto-promote)
tasks.summary: When ops-monitor info findings say N200 and/or N201 volume gate ready for review, open the matching Observe switcher tab (or observe JSON), read fair-cost path/lever brackets, and decide only whether a deliberate promotion design is warranted later. Do not promote, do not decision-review --apply, and do not open a second live capital path (F8).

tasks.title: Review N210 AI-judgment volume gate when ops-monitor marks ready (no auto-promote)
tasks.summary: When ops-monitor says N210 volume gate ready for review, open docs/data/n210_ai_judgment_observe.json, read fair-cost episode % + companions (N toward gate, weeks, buy-tier excess report-only), and decide only whether a deliberate assessment-primary design is warranted later. Do not promote, do not decision-review --apply, do not crown matched-30 as primary from this card (F8 / B3).

tasks.title: Verify decision packs before live capital
tasks.summary: For real-money trades, use decision-pack verify checklist and primary sources — separate from the automated learning loop.

tasks.title: Paper-learning review experiments
tasks.summary: When churn or exit-timing cohorts mature, run paper-learning review probes manually; do not auto-apply from shadow cohorts yet.

tasks.title: Change primary/control or freeze a learning track
tasks.summary: Human decision. Record it with apply_assessment_model() (src/value_investor/assessment_model.py) so the switch or freeze lands in paper_automation/assessment_model.json with date, reason, superseded_by and final NAV. B3 evidentiary demotion of ai_judgment_fair is stamped via policy_changes (evidentiary_demotion_ai_judgment_fair_v1) + apply_b3_lock(); do not enlarge the live 3-name book mid-flight; do not crown N210/matched-30 as primary until volume gates. Never edit or unfreeze a frozen book — start a twin. Market shards keep the legacy ai_judgment/rules pair.

tasks.title: Extend epoch-0 cron timezone map for new session
tasks.summary: When admitting a market with no MARKET_SESSION_DEFAULTS entry (or a timezone not in EPOCH0_WEEKDAY_SLOTS), add an explicit session + bucket mapping (e.g. tsx60	o America/Toronto	o US EDT/EST). Do not rely on the London DEFAULT_SESSION fallback. Then re-run euro-ingest-dispatch --sync-cron or import_cron_jobs for that key.

tasks.title: Re-import euro ingest cron slots after cadence change
tasks.summary: On main merge of import_cron_jobs.py / epoch0 slots / euro+library ingest workflow schedules, import-ingest-crons.yml re-imports Mon–Sat peak + daily off-peak slots (and epoch-0 buckets) on cron-job.org. Soft-skips when CRONJOB_API_KEY or WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_PAT is missing. Manual re-import only if the workflow was deleted or secrets were absent.

tasks.title: Register ops-monitor 02:30 UTC early hub on cron-job.org
tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title FTSE ops monitor early hub; jobId 8550657). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job ops-monitor-early. Keeps Daily hub fresh before 04:00 Europe/London. GitHub schedule is backup. Verify next day with gh run list --workflow=ops-monitor.yml (expect workflow_dispatch ~02:30 UTC).

tasks.title: Register ops-monitor 13:15 UTC catch-up on cron-job.org
tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title FTSE ops monitor catch-up). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job ops-monitor-catchup. GitHub schedule is backup. Verify with gh run list --workflow=ops-monitor.yml.

tasks.title: Register project-traffic weekday crons
tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (midday 12:30 + EOD 17:30 UTC weekdays). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job project-traffic-midday --job project-traffic-eod. GitHub schedule is backup only.

tasks.title: Rotate CURSOR_API_KEY after suspected exposure
tasks.summary: If Cursor API misuse or GitHub secret exposure is suspected: revoke the key in the Cursor dashboard, set a new GitHub Actions secret (and any Cloud/cron copies), review odd workflow_run jobs, and confirm main workflow files were not planted. Prefer main branch protection so a stolen GITHUB_TOKEN cannot push exfil workflows.

tasks.title: Register daily GHA secret-hygiene cron on cron-job.org
tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title GHA secret hygiene). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job gha-secret-hygiene. GitHub schedule is backup. Verify with gh run list --workflow=gha-secret-hygiene.yml.

tasks.title: Register dashboard-bridge every-10m cron on cron-job.org (all days)
tasks.summary: Already live on cron-job.org (title FTSE dashboard bridge (every 10m), jobId 8513740, wdays [-1] all days). Re-import only if deleted: import_cron_jobs.py --job dashboard-bridge. GitHub */10 schedule is backup and often drifts hours. Verify with gh run list --workflow=dashboard-bridge.yml.

tasks.title: Sync valid Cursor API key into GitHub Actions secrets
tasks.summary: When ftse-verify-key --key-source legacy fails but --key-source v2 succeeds (or GHA agent jobs 401): copy the valid User API key into GitHub Actions secrets CURSOR_API_KEY_V2 and CURSOR_API_KEY. Workflows prefer V2 via secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY_V2 || secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY. Cloud secrets alone do not feed Actions.

tasks.title: Review open ingest deviations and reprocess if needed
tasks.summary: When Automation → Ingest deviations shows open rows, follow observe-only signal_triage (leftover → dismiss, buy → park/hunter via dismiss, strong_buy → approve pin). Approve writes a 7-day intensive pin; dismiss closes 7 days. Do not auto-replace IR URLs.

tasks.title: Override FCF auto policy only when majority/filing is wrong
tasks.summary: Ordinary buy-tier FCF mismatches auto-resolve (majority among screen/filing/company-adjusted, else filing-aligned OCF−CapEx). Write docs/data/research/<TICKER>/sources/fcf_bridge.json only as a residual override when that auto pick is wrong, or when so-what flags fcf_bridge_needed because no filing/company figure exists. Never leave divergent Yahoo TTM as policy.

tasks.title: Buy one month of point-in-time US data and run the registered screen replay
tasks.summary: Phase 2 of the historical screen replay (L536/L542) and its mid-cap sibling (hsr-mid-v1). Personal-use sharadar.com direct Bundle, Full History, monthly plan ($69; the $29 Bundle is 5 years only); follow the day-by-day table in the runbook. The free-sample dry run of build-panel passed on 2026-10-08. Keep the API key in a local environment variable, never in the repo, chat, or cloud secrets. On day 1 bulk-download every bundle table (years=full) outside the repo. Do not publish judgements on the data's quality or fitness (licence s.8): build_report.json stays out of the repo. Build both universes (build-panel, and build-panel --universe midcap) and check both build_report.json files, run both development windows (baseline and --variant dividend_units_fixed), run the rule search (ftse-rule-search search) and the model-mix search (ftse-model-mix search --build --midcap-build) and commit both selections, reveal each holdout once (run --reveal-holdout, with and without --universe midcap), run the delisting sensitivity for both, then ftse-rule-search reveal and ftse-model-mix reveal, then re-run the exploratory --variant dividend_units_fixed on both. Commit only the replay, mid-cap, rule-search, and model-mix stores (aggregates and series). Cancel and delete all raw tables, panels, caches and daily files within 30 days, then run ftse-historical-replay confirm-deleted (ops-monitor warns 60 days after first use until confirmed). Never change a registration after its reveal.
